narrative.overview: Prisma's cinematic Hero leads into a unified light paper product interface. Every public route and micro-component uses the same ink, paper, border, typography, and motion vocabulary while preserving all existing behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Playing inset Hero video with a processed outer-frame still.
Pure light paper sections below the Hero.
Bookman English display with Songti and Kaiti Chinese typography.
Grayscale commands and semantic green state feedback.
One Prisma component vocabulary across every public route.

rules.name: The Grayscale Command Rule
rules.body: Commands are black, white, or gray. Green never fills a button.

rules.name: The White Below Rule
rules.body: About, features, analytics, contact, and footer remain on light paper.

rules.name: The No Rounded Type Rule
rules.body: Rounded geometric display faces are prohibited in the public redesign.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: A resting component has no shadow, glow, or gradient text.

dos: Do preserve every existing SoloFirm function, route, filter, control, API call, source link, content block, authentication action, and SVG brand mark.
Do keep Hero and lower feature videos playing as specified.
Do maintain readable ink contrast on every light card and control.
Do use black, white, and gray for all command buttons.
donts: Don't remove a feature because it does not fit the new composition.
Don't use blue or multicolor button fills, gradient text, glow, or text shadows.
Don't allow one public route or micro-component to retain the old visual system.
Don't put Hero imagery behind lower white sections.
